_meta.description: NPC gifts, eggs, and in-game trades for the Routes list. Built from encounters.json method gift/trade/egg and dex.json how. Best effort: the wiki extract often names the town and the species, not the level or the exact NPC.
_meta.heuristic: A hatched or special egg whose met location is a town with an egg source is suggested for that source. A species gift matches own OT, the same met location, and a species on that source. An in-game trade matches the species plus either met location 254 or another trainer's OT in that town. Levels are not required unless a source sets one. Mystery gifts and cloud trades have no met location, so they are listed and not auto-suggested. Eggs still in the box are skipped before this runs. Map section 133 is the starter rule, not a gift.
